reuse.why: Holiday matching is extracted into a shared isHoliday used by isNonWorkingDay and the daily-schedule path, though app.ts re-composes 'weekend or holiday' itself instead of exporting and calling the existing isNonWorkingDay.

duplication.why: The two holiday checks now share one definition; the weekend-or-holiday disjunction remains written twice (isNonWorkingDay and getDatesInRange).

placement.why: The date rule lives in shared/schedules.ts next to the other non-working-day logic and is consumed by the server handler.

scope.why: Only the holiday matching, its two call sites and tests are changed.

maintainability.why: A small, readable helper makes the MM-DD rule one place; the leftover inline weekend-or-holiday expression and an out-of-order import are minor.
